name: Status dot
description: A small coloured dot that shows the state of something, like someone being online, a live stream or a server's health.

classes.ayy-status-dot--pulse: Animated pinging ring for live/active statuses (keyframes ayy-status-dot-ping).

default.looks: A circular dot with hairline ring for contrast against light and dark backgrounds. Neutral muted colour by default.

hover.none: A status dot is a static indicator, not an interactive control.

pressed.none: A status dot is a static indicator, not an interactive control.

disabled.none: A status dot is a static indicator, not an interactive control.

selected.none: A status dot is a static indicator, not an interactive control.

error.none: Static indicator; use destructive variant (ayy-status-dot--destructive) for error or failed status.

loading.none: Static indicator; use pulse (ayy-status-dot--pulse) for live or active statuses, or Spinner for pending operations.

sizes.density: Fixed dot dimensions (6px, 8px, or 10px); does not scale with data-density.
sizes.width: Fixed square footprint matching dot dimensions.

scale.sm: 6px diameter for dense table rows or nested badges.
scale.md: 8px diameter standard dot for status rows and presence.
scale.lg: 10px diameter prominent dot for live indicators and headers.

js: statusDotClass({ variant?, size?, pulse?, className? }) → string

props.pulse: boolean — animated pinging ring for live/active status
props.label: string — accessible label (sets role="status" and aria-label; without it, aria-hidden="true")

a11y: Colour is never the only signal — accompany standalone status dots with a text label or pass the label prop so screen readers announce it.
When label is provided, sets role="status" and aria-label; when omitted, aria-hidden="true" treats the dot as decorative.
do: Use a status dot to indicate online presence, server or service health, or active streaming status.
Place the status dot beside a descriptive label or table cell value.
Use the pulse modifier for active or real-time statuses like live streams or ongoing recordings.
dont: Don't rely on color alone to convey meaning without an accompanying label or tooltip.
Don't make a status dot clickable directly — wrap in a button or link if interaction is required.
Don't use a status dot for counts or numerical badges — use Badge instead.
